securityInvariants: Core SEIS AI must start with zero cloud provider keys.
Browser code must not receive model-provider secrets.
Provider keys must be backend-only and never stored in localStorage or IndexedDB.
Missing Key and Disabled states must not be routed silently.
Rate Limited and Error states must use redacted output and must not print raw provider responses.
Local-only mode must never fall back to a cloud provider.
Unavailable providers must remain visibly unavailable in SEIS AI surfaces.
nextSafeActions: Use this fixture as the provider status source for SEIS AI and MCP evidence.
